claims.excerpt: Introduction of T Levels
T Levels are 2-year courses which are taken after GCSEs and are broadly equivalent in size to 3 A Levels.

claims.excerpt: an industry placement of at least 315 hours – approximately 45 days
We expect the typical time to be between 1100 and 1300 classroom hours across the 2 years plus the mandatory Industry Placement of at least 315 hours.
claims.note: over the 2 years

claims.excerpt: T Levels require students to undertake both a technical qualification and an industry placement with an employer.

claims.excerpt: Students who complete their T Level get a nationally recognised certificate which shows their overall grade and a breakdown of what they have achieved.
